name: Mobile Joe
description: Official hosted server for Mobile Joe, a toolkit for mobile app developers. Maintains FAQs and their translations, curates feature plans, informs app users with in-app alerts and updates app settings. 33 tools; drafts are prepared and content is published or delivered only when asked. OAuth and a Mobile Joe account are required (14-day free trial); during consent the developer chooses which apps and permissions to share.
author: Bytekontor GmbH
